Subject: Upcoming APAC1 compatibility validation & safeguard window — Nov 09, 2026

Hello Samir / Priya,

We are planning a focused validation window in the APAC1 region on Tuesday, Nov 09 2026 between 02:00 - 06:00 UTC (local evening/night hours for your team). This work is a staged compatibility validation ahead of a broader driver/kernel refresh scheduled for Q1 2027. The purpose is to run suffix/prefix KV-cache warmup, run compatibility checks against pinned model variants, and validate our automatic safeguard fallbacks.

What to expect:
- Brief, rolling restarts on a small subset of nodes (targeted, <10% of capacity) — we will route traffic to healthy capacity during checks.
- Short-lived 1–3 minute connection resets may occur for affected backend connections.
- No data-plane changes to customer model artifacts; requests and persisted data will not be modified.

Planned safeguards we will run:
1) Canary validation against your test tenant and a reserved capacity slice.
2) Automated rollback to the previous kernel/driver bundle if error rates exceed predefined thresholds.
3) Live traffic throttling and gateway-level circuit-breakers to protect production latencies.

Action items for Aurum Health:
- Please confirm a point-of-contact for the window (name + mobile).
- If you have any pinned instance IDs or traffic routing constraints, reply with those by EOD Oct 20.

Attachments: apac1-safeguard-checklist.pdf (short checklist), compatibility-matrix-v2.xlsx

If this window is not acceptable, we can propose an alternate slot within the same week. Thanks — we will follow up with a final confirmation 48 hours prior to the window.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
